summary.en: A catch-all for guitar rock outside the mainstream—then the mainstream itself.
summary.zh: 主流之外的吉他摇滚集合名词，后成为主流本身。

body.en: Alternative begins as a radio category and becomes a generation's default rock. From college experiment to hit singles, it holds Radiohead-style evolution and the scattered streams after Grunge.
body.zh: Alternative 起初是电台分类，后来变成一代人的默认摇滚。从学院派实验到电台热单，它包容 Radiohead 式演进，也承接 Grunge 之后的散落支流。
